selected.notes: Four worker beds in diagonal primary/secondary pairs; eight village-banner slots; four personal barrels; exact quartermaster, builder, captain and miner stations; four captured snow golems. The quartermaster and miner route to the naturally placed storehouse and mine.
One double bed, both halves secondary; shared personal chest.
Two separate single beds.
One single bed.
Storehouse with two reachable village-storage barrels and the quartermaster worksite. The lowest barrel behind the stack remains visual and is not declared storage.
Three separate single beds.
Butcher building; animal enclosure receives three sheep.
Fishing hut with one bed and one barrel.
Orchard shell converted for lumberjack; dead bush marks a spruce sapling; includes bed and two barrels.

Sole watchtower tier with a crossbow guard post, worker bed and personal chest. A final ladder rung and closed spruce landing gate preserve the rail silhouette while allowing the guard to return home.
Chemist shell repurposed as the first church.
Bed and personal chest beside it; workstation chest across the room.
Bed with personal barrel; separate workstation chest.
Compact wheat-and-carrot farm with storage barrel.
Larger berry and glow-berry greenhouse.
The north-facing doorway leads to the user-carved, continuous three-block-wide shaft running south through local x=3..5, z=4..9. Mine access geometry passed review.
Selected and user-edited hunter building; one bed, two chests, furnace, fire and target.
Selected and user-edited bakery; one logical bed, smoker, cakes and the retained snowy outdoor bake-fire roof.
Five logical beds: two upstairs reserved for two tavern keepers and three downstairs for general housing. Three source structure-void markers must be stripped in production.
Selected compact blue-ice and stone-brick well feature.

All three repaired counter, entrance and trapdoor patterns passed structural, visual and physical access review. Each stall has exactly one supported entrance carpet and keeps the established red, cyan, orange and white trade colors. Counter barrels sit above a complete stone-brick foundation.
One wall level only. The reviewed palette is snow block, packed-ice accents, spruce rails and trapdoors, stone-brick slabs, lanterns and single lit brown candles.
